player_prompt.intro:
Eŋu ŋko na Player {player_id} ({role}) le {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies ɖɔwɔme.
- Eɖɔ le ɖɔwɔme ɖeka, na miɖɛ [heads] kple [tails] (kple [h], [t]).
- Eɖɔ ɖi le ɖɔwɔme ɖi ɖe na miɖɛ ɖe ɖi, Player 0 wɔ ɖɔwɔme; ɖɔwɔme ɖi ɖe na, Player 1 wɔ.
Miɖɛ na ɖi le ɖɔwɔta '[heads]' kple '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dɔwɔta ɖɛ ɖi; miɖɛ na '[heads]' kple '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Player 0 xɔ {choice0}; Player 1 xɔ {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 wɔ.
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Mismatch -> Player 1 wins.
